note: Generic OBD-II powertrain codes (P0xxx), 1996+ US vehicles. Titles paraphrase the code definitions standardized in SAE J2012 / ISO 15031-6. The causes and checks lists are unsourced drafts and stay hidden until cited.

sources.title: SAE J2012: Diagnostic Trouble Code Definitions
ISO 15031-6: Road vehicles, communication between vehicle and external equipment for emissions-related diagnostics, Part 6: Diagnostic trouble code definitions

P0010.title: Intake ("A") camshaft actuator circuit, bank 1
causes: Open or shorted VVT/oil control solenoid
Wiring or connector fault to solenoid
checks: Measure solenoid resistance against spec
Command solenoid with a scan tool and listen for a click

P0011.title: Intake ("A") camshaft timing over-advanced or performance, bank 1
causes: Low or dirty oil, wrong viscosity
Sticking VVT/oil control solenoid or clogged screen
checks: Check oil level and condition first
Compare desired vs actual cam angle on the scan tool

P0012.title: Intake ("A") camshaft timing over-retarded, bank 1
causes: Timing chain stretch or jumped tooth
checks: Check oil
Look for P0016/P0017 alongside, which points to chain stretch

P0016.title: Crankshaft/camshaft position correlation, bank 1 sensor A
checks: Check cam/crank correlation values on the scan tool
Scope cam and crank signals together

P0030.title: O2 sensor heater control circuit, bank 1 sensor 1
causes: Failed heater element in upstream O2 sensor
checks: Measure heater resistance at the sensor connector
Check for 12 V feed with key on

P0100.title: Mass air flow (MAF) circuit malfunction
checks: Check power, ground and signal at the MAF

P0101.title: MAF circuit range/performance
causes: Vacuum leak after the MAF (unmetered air)
checks: Compare MAF g/s at idle to roughly engine liters x 1 to 1.5
Smoke test the intake

P0102.title: MAF circuit low input
checks: Back-probe signal; check reference and ground

P0103.title: MAF circuit high input
checks: Check signal wire for short to power

P0106.title: MAP/barometric pressure circuit range/performance
causes: Cracked or disconnected MAP vacuum hose
checks: Key on engine off, MAP should read close to baro
Vacuum gauge test

P0107.title: MAP circuit low input
checks: Check 5 V reference at the connector

P0108.title: MAP circuit high input
checks: Check sensor ground

P0112.title: Intake air temperature (IAT) circuit low
checks: Unplug sensor; reading should jump to very cold

P0113.title: Intake air temperature (IAT) circuit high
checks: Jumper the connector; reading should jump to very hot

P0117.title: Engine coolant temperature (ECT) circuit low
checks: Compare ECT to IAT on a cold engine

P0118.title: Engine coolant temperature (ECT) circuit high
checks: Check connector first; these corrode

P0121.title: Throttle position sensor A range/performance
checks: Sweep throttle slowly and graph TPS for dropouts

P0122.title: Throttle position sensor A circuit low
checks: Check 5 V reference and ground

P0123.title: Throttle position sensor A circuit high
checks: Check sensor ground

P0125.title: Coolant temperature too low for closed-loop fuel control
checks: Watch ECT warm-up curve on the scan tool

P0128.title: Coolant below thermostat regulating temperature
causes: Thermostat stuck open or wrong rating
checks: Engine should reach about 180-195 F in 10-15 min of driving on most cars

P0131.title: O2 sensor circuit low voltage, bank 1 sensor 1
checks: Check for exhaust leaks
Snap throttle; a good sensor swings high

P0132.title: O2 sensor circuit high voltage, bank 1 sensor 1
checks: Check for leaking injectors or high fuel pressure

P0133.title: O2 sensor slow response, bank 1 sensor 1
checks: Graph sensor switching rate at 2500 rpm

P0134.title: O2 sensor no activity, bank 1 sensor 1
checks: Check heater circuit and signal wire

P0135.title: O2 sensor heater circuit, bank 1 sensor 1
checks: Measure heater resistance; check fuse

P0137.title: O2 sensor circuit low voltage, bank 1 sensor 2
checks: Check for exhaust leaks near the cat

P0138.title: O2 sensor circuit high voltage, bank 1 sensor 2
checks: Check wiring

P0141.title: O2 sensor heater circuit, bank 1 sensor 2
checks: Measure heater resistance

P0171.title: System too lean, bank 1
causes: Vacuum leak (intake gasket, PCV, brake booster hose)
Weak fuel pump or clogged filter
Exhaust leak ahead of upstream O2
checks: Look at fuel trims: lean at idle but better at 2500 rpm points to a vacuum leak; lean everywhere points to fuel or MAF
Smoke test
Fuel pressure test

P0172.title: System too rich, bank 1
checks: Fuel pressure and leak-down test
Check oil for fuel smell

P0174.title: System too lean, bank 2
causes: Same as P0171; both banks lean together points to MAF, fuel supply or a central vacuum leak
checks: Compare trims bank to bank

P0175.title: System too rich, bank 2
checks: Compare trims bank to bank

P0230.title: Fuel pump primary circuit
checks: Check relay and fuse; listen for prime at key-on

P0300.title: Random/multiple cylinder misfire detected
checks: Check misfire counters by cylinder
Fuel trims and fuel pressure
Compression test if mechanical

P0325.title: Knock sensor 1 circuit (bank 1 or single sensor)
checks: Check sensor resistance/output and harness continuity

P0335.title: Crankshaft position sensor A circuit
checks: Check for rpm signal while cranking
Scope the sensor

P0340.title: Camshaft position sensor A circuit (bank 1 or single sensor)
checks: Check sensor power, ground and signal
Verify timing if sensor checks out

P0401.title: EGR flow insufficient
checks: Command EGR open at idle; engine should stumble
Clean passages

P0402.title: EGR flow excessive
checks: Check valve seats closed with engine off

P0411.title: Secondary air injection incorrect flow
checks: Listen for pump at cold start
Check valves for moisture/corrosion

P0420.title: Catalyst efficiency below threshold, bank 1
causes: Exhaust leak near the downstream O2
Engine misfire or oil burning that damaged the cat
checks: Fix misfires and fuel-trim problems first
Compare upstream and downstream O2: downstream should be steady, not mirroring upstream

P0430.title: Catalyst efficiency below threshold, bank 2
checks: Same as P0420

P0440.title: Evaporative emission (EVAP) system malfunction
checks: Check the gas cap seal
Smoke test EVAP system

P0441.title: EVAP incorrect purge flow
checks: Command purge valve and check for vacuum

P0442.title: EVAP small leak detected
causes: Cracked hose at the canister or filler neck
checks: Smoke test with the system sealed

P0443.title: EVAP purge control valve circuit
checks: Measure solenoid resistance

P0446.title: EVAP vent control circuit
causes: Clogged canister (often from overfilling at the pump)
checks: Command vent closed and check it holds

P0449.title: EVAP vent valve/solenoid circuit
causes: Wiring or connector corrosion near the tank
checks: Check power and ground at the vent solenoid

P0455.title: EVAP large leak detected
checks: Smoke test; large leaks usually show quickly

P0456.title: EVAP very small leak detected
checks: Smoke test, take your time

P0500.title: Vehicle speed sensor A malfunction
causes: ABS wheel speed input fault on vehicles that share it
checks: Compare scan-tool speed to actual while driving

P0505.title: Idle air control system malfunction
causes: Carbon-clogged IAC valve or throttle body
checks: Clean throttle body and IAC passage

P0506.title: Idle rpm lower than expected
checks: Clean throttle body; run idle relearn if required

P0507.title: Idle rpm higher than expected
checks: Smoke test; check throttle return

P0562.title: System voltage low
checks: Charging-system test; voltage-drop test on cables

P0563.title: System voltage high
checks: Measure charging voltage at the battery

P0601.title: Control module internal memory checksum error
checks: Check for PCM reflash updates before replacing

P0700.title: Transmission control system (MIL request)
causes: The TCM has stored its own code
checks: Read transmission codes with a scan tool that reaches the TCM

P0715.title: Input/turbine speed sensor A circuit
checks: Check sensor signal; inspect for metal debris

P0720.title: Output speed sensor circuit
checks: Check sensor signal while driving

P0740.title: Torque converter clutch circuit
checks: Measure solenoid resistance through the case connector

P0750.title: Shift solenoid A malfunction
checks: Measure solenoid resistance; check fluid level and condition

P0755.title: Shift solenoid B malfunction
checks: Measure solenoid resistance; check fluid level and condition

U0100.title: Lost communication with ECM/PCM A
checks: Check PCM powers and grounds
Measure CAN resistance at the DLC: about 60 ohms between pins 6 and 14 with the key off

U0101.title: Lost communication with TCM
checks: Check TCM powers and grounds

U0121.title: Lost communication with ABS module
checks: Check ABS fuses and grounds

U0140.title: Lost communication with body control module
checks: Check BCM fuses and grounds

families.title: Injector circuit open, cylinder {n}
checks: Measure injector resistance; noid light test

families.title: Cylinder {n} misfire detected
causes: Spark plug or coil/plug wire on that cylinder
checks: Swap the coil to another cylinder and see if the misfire follows
Compression or leak-down test

families.title: Ignition coil {L} primary/secondary circuit (cylinder {n} on most engines)
checks: Check coil power and driver signal
